description: This file defines a React functional component named CreditBreakdownModal that renders a modal dialog showing a detailed breakdown of credits and minutes per project. It imports React, a Modal component, and a utility function for rendering credits with USD formatting. The component displays a table with project name, total credits, and total minutes, handling empty states and dynamic data rendering.

methods.name: CreditBreakdownModal
methods.description: React functional component that renders a modal with a credit breakdown table.
